changelog:
- Initial release of the WebCrawlerAPI skill.
- Supports scraping single pages to markdown or crawling full websites for multiple markdown files.
- Requires users to set their API key as the WEBCRAWLERAPI_API_KEY environment variable.
- Implements decision logic to choose between single-page scrape and multi-page crawl based on user input.
- Scraped content is output directly; crawled content is saved in a structured local directory.
- Provides user-friendly error handling and detailed crawl summaries.
summary: Scrape a single page or crawl a full website using WebCrawlerAPI. Trigger for: fetching page content, getting markdown from a URL, scraping a page, crawling...
